name: r2bot-kids-mobile
description: R2BOT Kids standalone app (Capacitor). Every /kids page is bundled in www/ (static export, scripts/kids-app/build-export.mjs); no network needed.

scripts.build:apk: npm run export:www && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
